messages.content: "Could you help me with a few things? First, I'm interested in finding out all the movies that actor Leonardo DiCaprio starred in the year 2010, specifically in the Drama category. Second, I'd like to know about any lawsuits filed against the company 'Apple Inc.' in the location 'California' in the year 2015, and I'm particularly interested in civil cases. Lastly, I need to book a direct flight from 'New York' to 'London' on the date '2022-12-25', and I prefer the time to be around '10:00AM'. Can you assist me with these?"

function.name: lawsuits_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits against a specific company within a specific time and location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location where the lawsuit was filed.

year.description: The year when the lawsuit was filed.

case_type.description: The type of the case. Options include: 'civil', 'criminal', 'small_claims', etc. If not specified, default to search for all types.

function.name: flight_book
function.description: Book a direct flight for a specific date and time from departure location to destination location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

departure_location.description: The location you are departing from.

destination_location.description: The location you are flying to.

date.description: The date of the flight. Accepts standard date format e.g., 2022-04-28.

time.description: Preferred time of flight. Format XX:XXAM or XX:XXPM. Default ''

direct_flight.description: If set to true, only direct flights will be searched. Default is false

function.name: imdb_find_movies_by_actor
function.description: Searches the database to find all movies by a specific actor within a certain year. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

year.description: The specific year to search in.

category.description: The category of the film (e.g. Drama, Comedy, etc). This parameter is optional. Default is all if not specified.
